requirement.statement: The system SHALL provide an owner-local revisioned XNL authoring session in which accepted Domain XNL is the only live authority and all human, Agent, Presenter and embedded-block edits enter as immutable proposals.

case.given: A proposal carries a base live revision different from the session accepted revision.
case.then: The session SHALL return conflict before candidate materialization and SHALL NOT advance accepted or persisted state.

case.given: Multiple callers submit edits to one authoring session.
case.then: Requests SHALL be serialized through the runtime-first ValueHost owner and no caller SHALL receive AST, VFS writer or persistence authority.

requirement.statement: The system SHALL process each semantic edit through Command, Candidate, identity-aware diff, strict clone-based dry-run, validation and acceptance as one ordered mutation batch without mutating the accepted base during evaluation.

case.given: A candidate moves an identified node or replaces its identity.
case.when: The XNL adapter diffs and dry-runs the candidate.
case.then: #id SHALL act as tree alignment and move identity, SHALL NOT be emitted as an ordinary payload update, and identity replacement SHALL be delete plus add.

case.given: Dry-run or domain validation rejects a mutation batch.
case.then: The accepted snapshot, live revision, persisted revision and persistence authority SHALL remain unchanged.

case.given: An Interaction is translated to a valid Domain Command and accepted.
case.when: The accepted Domain XNL is compiled again.
case.then: The resulting ProjectionPlan SHALL reflect the semantic edit and no Presenter-local draft SHALL become a domain fact.

requirement.statement: The system SHALL distinguish live acceptance from VFS/VCS persistence, use expected persisted revision CAS, and expose applied, unchanged, failed and conflicted persistence outcomes without reporting an unpersisted edit as saved.

case.given: A candidate is accepted live and the persistence effect fails.
case.then: The accepted live revision SHALL remain advanced, persisted revision SHALL remain unchanged, the session SHALL be dirty-failed, and new edits SHALL fail closed until retry or recovery.

case.given: A candidate passes dry-run and validation and is accepted live.
case.when: The following persistence effect is pending, fails, or conflicts.
case.then: The session SHALL publish the accepted live invalidation exactly once so projections reflect the live authority while save state remains explicitly unpersisted.

case.given: The persistence authority has advanced independently.
case.when: The session persists with a stale expected persisted revision.
case.then: The session SHALL expose persistence-conflicted with the actual revision and SHALL require reload or rebase before another edit.

case.given: An accepted snapshot was persisted successfully.
case.when: A new session reloads through the injected persistence port.
case.then: The reloaded Domain XNL SHALL structurally equal the persisted accepted snapshot and the persistence receipt SHALL remain separate from live revision.

case.given: A dirty-failed or persistence-conflicted session and an expected current live revision.
case.when: The host explicitly reloads while discarding the accepted live divergence.
case.then: The session SHALL read the persisted snapshot, allocate a new live revision, publish invalidation, report the discarded revision, and SHALL conflict rather than discard when expected live revision is stale.

case.given: The VFS authority reports an unchanged structurally equal snapshot.
case.then: The session SHALL become persisted at the returned revision and MUST NOT fabricate an applied persistence receipt.

requirement.statement: The system SHALL obtain materialization, diff, dry-run, validation, persistence, revision and invalidation capabilities from the runtime first argument; input and config MUST NOT carry function objects, registries, writers or persistence clients.

case.given: The contract, logic and support package graph.
case.when: Dependencies and public surfaces are scanned.
case.then: Only support SHALL import xnl-core or xnl-vfs, and no layer SHALL import Tiptap, ProseMirror, Vue, DOM or xnl-vcs implementation.
